localContext: Flatlands' tree-lined streets, backyard gardens, and proximity to Marine Park create ideal conditions for stinging insect activity, especially during spring and summer months. The neighborhood's many older homes with eaves, attics, and wall voids provide perfect nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets — paper nests built inside wall cavities can grow to basketball size and require professional treatment to eliminate the colony and seal entry points. Carpenter bees bore into fascia boards, railings, and exposed wood trim throughout the residential sections.
